name: Google Gemini
description: Writes the prompt from your description (typed or dictated), draws the pictures of the subject and its other three sides, and turns a description of a metalwork job into the measures of the project. The 3D model and the sculpture are then made by AutoSculpt 3D.
license: Paid service with a free quota; pictures and texts may be used commercially under the Gemini API terms
price: about 0.04 USD per picture; texts and dictation cost a fraction of a cent
key_hint: Google AI Studio → Get API key (pictures need billing enabled on the project)
